claim: New year goals are awesome, but one focus will have a more dramatic impact on transforming your life than anything else: intentional discomfort

The one focus with more impact on transforming your life than anything else is not the gym, a better diet or a particular change in your relationships, business or work: those are all great, but the one thing is getting uncomfortable
Two things are true about getting uncomfortable
All growth happens through getting uncomfortable
You do not grow when things feel nice and safe and comfortable

A new way of eating, a new way of communicating with your spouse, putting in the physical work, voicing your opinion at work: each is uncomfortable, at least at the start, and that is where growth happens
Think more fundamentally than your body, weight or job goals: we change by committing to being uncomfortable, "I am willing to go out today in every aspect of my life and step into discomfort"
Getting uncomfortable is where you access your deepest self: your gateway to the real you, in that quiet space that's powerful beyond explanation
Physical effort, cold exposure, stepping up socially in a way you haven't before: discomfort forces you to a deeper, more quiet, central, powerful place
If you never listen to another word of this podcast, listen to this: pursue discomfort and you will grow, and experience the version of you and the life you want to experience
Discomfort that feels sort of forced upon you, a divorce, a job change, is the same as intentional discomfort: an opportunity to use it as a tool to go deeper within yourself and grow
Whether you choose discomfort or it's happening to you, discomfort is where it's at
To make 2020 the best year of your life, one thing will surely get you there more than anything else: put yourself in uncomfortable places, do uncomfortable things
As a way to do uncomfortable things, if it's cold where you wake up, walk outside: it's not about being warm
As a way to do uncomfortable things, start your day with a cold shower

Beyond the many benefits of cold therapy for your body, a cold shower at the start of the day is choosing discomfort, saying at the start of the day that you are willing to get uncomfortable because that leads where you want to go and uncovers the version of you that you can feel inside
Exclusively cold showers for the last four or five years
As a way to do uncomfortable things, work physically hard
Be willing to get uncomfortable with a change of diet, a social interaction, a thing at work, interactions with your spouse: don't resist that, pursue it
Pursue discomfort and you will transform your life and your life experience more than through any other possible thing, in ways you can only imagine
The singular goal for 2020: to look back at its end and say other guys were helped to kick ass, feel good and have a better year than the year before
